title: Deleting an Issue from the Active Directory Issue Safelist

blocks.text: You can remove an issue from the Active Directory Issue Safelist page.
To remove the issue from the Active Directory Issue Safelist:

blocks.item: Go to Settings > ITDR Safelist > Active Directory Issue Safelist.
Select an AD domain from the Result for drop-down menu.
Under Actions, click the Delete icon to remove the issue from the safelist.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
The issue is added to the Focus Area page and the new and previous vulnerability reports for the selected AD domain.
